name: bike-metaobjects
description: Bike builder v2 — metaobject-based architecture for the Alpkit Shopify theme
summary: This tool is an upgraded bike builder for the Alpkit Shopify theme that uses a structured system to manage bike options and pricing more reliably. It is designed for Shopify theme developers and product managers to replace the old tag-based system, ensuring accurate pricing and easier customization of bike products. This solves issues with incorrect pricing and fragile product configurations in the online store.
